Enable.description: Whether to delete Umbraco Forms submissions (records and their field data) on startup.

Uploads.description: Whether to also empty the Forms upload directory. Default true; only applies when Enable is true.

UploadsPath.description: The Forms upload directory to empty when Uploads is true. Defaults to wwwroot/media/forms/upload. May be relative (resolved against the content root) or absolute, but must be strictly inside the content root.
